We’d love feedback on the approach, architecture, or potential edge cases we should think about.

items.title: I built an AI planner that works backward from your deadline
items.raw_excerpt:
I’ve always struggled with planning. Setting a deadline was easy, but figuring out what I should be doing today was always the hard part. Most tools assume you plan forward from day 1, but in real life you usually start with a fixed date — an exam, a trip, a launch, a wedding.
I kept failing to stay consistent because forward planning never told me when each step should realistically happen. A few years ago I discovered “reverse planning”:
start with the deadline → work backward → define the checkpoints → then fill in the tasks leading to today. It worked extremely well for me, but I couldn’t find a tool that supported it properly. Everything was built for forward scheduling. So I ended up building one. Some interesting challenges along the way: - Figuring out how to anchor tasks to dates

items.title: Benchmarking leading AI agents against Google reCAPTCHA v2
items.raw_excerpt: We evaluate three leading AI models—Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and GPT-5—on their ability to solve Google reCAPTCHA v2 challenges and find significant performance differences, with success rates ranging from 28% to 60%.

title_i18n.es: Comparación de los principales agentes de inteligencia artificial con Google reCAPTCHA v2

excerpt_i18n.en: We evaluate three leading AI models—Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and GPT-5—on their ability to solve Google reCAPTCHA v2 challenges and find significant performance differences, with success rates ranging from 28% to 60%.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我们评估了Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Pro和GPT-5这三款领先AI模型解决Google reCAPTCHA v2验证的能力，发现其表现存在显著差异，成功率在28%至不等。
excerpt_i18n.es: Evaluamos tres modelos de IA punteros —Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Pro y GPT-5— en su capacidad para resolver desafíos de Google reCAPTCHA v2 y encontramos diferencias significativas de rendimiento, con tasas de éxito que oscilan entre el 28 %.

items.title: Launch HN: Hypercubic (YC F25) – AI for COBOL and Mainframes
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, we’re Sai and Aayush and we’re building Hypercubic ( https://www.hypercubic.ai/ )! Hypercubic is an AI platform that helps Fortune 500 companies understand, preserve, and modernize their mainframe systems. These are the systems that run COBOL from the 1960s that still quietly power banking, insurance, airlines, and governments today. 70% of the Fortune 500 still run on mainframes, but the engineers who built and maintained them are retiring. Today, the average age of a COBOL/mainframe engineer is about 55 and rapidly increasing. What’s left behind are opaque, black box systems with almost no one who understands how they work.
